current_math_audit_2026_11_20.mathematics_verified: Sharp graph-correspondence distortion Θ(epsilon^2) for d=5 and Θ(epsilon) for d>=6 for the synthetic metric; GH upper bounds only. Proved finite no-shortcut/square-lifts/fibre-connector criterion and a two-squares-wedged-at-origin counterexample showing connector necessity. Proved conditional Euler singular-fibre budget N_d=d^4-5d^3+9d^2-3d-10 for the threefold complement, with isolated nonzero Euler fibres as an indispensable hypothesis (N_6=512). Existing degree/genus and Petersen results retained.
